name: GitHub commit security review
description: Clone a repository on the plugin host, have a Claude agent read the last N commits in that checkout, and write one Stage row per security finding — schema-bound, deduplicated, and left at disposition `pending` for a human to promote.

owner.label: GitHub organization / owner
owner.description: The owner the repository belongs to, used when Repository is given as a bare name. It must match the organization / owner set on the GitHub account profile you bind the two GitHub nodes to — those actions take a repository name only and read the owner from that profile.

repo.label: Repository
repo.description: The repository. A bare name (fiberValidation), owner/name, or a GitHub URL — including an ssh remote or a link to a file inside it — all work. When the value carries an owner, it overrides the Owner param, since it is the more specific statement.

commits.label: Commits to review
commits.description: How many commits back from the branch head to read. The clone is made one commit deeper so the oldest reviewed commit still has a parent to diff against.

ref.label: Branch, tag or commit
ref.description: What to check out. Leave empty for the repository's default branch.

severityFloor.label: Severity floor
severityFloor.description: Findings below this severity are dropped before anything is written to Stage.

flows.title: GitHub commit security review → venapce Stage
flows.description: Clone + commit list in parallel → agent review of the checkout with a schema-bound answer → normalize → map onto the Stage schema → one Stage row per finding.

plugins.name: Github-Dev
plugins.note: Needs a GitHub account connected in FloMorphic → Connect, and git on the plugin's host.

plugins.name: Claude
plugins.note: Needs Claude Code installed on the plugin's host and either logged in or given an API key in its settings profile.

settings.for: Clone the repository, List the recent commits
settings.note: A GitHub account profile whose organization is the `owner` param.

A Claude profile whose workspace root contains the GitHub plugin's clone root (GITHUB_OC_CLONE_ROOT, or ./workspace beside that plugin). Both plugins must run on the same host, or share that directory.
